title: Patterns
excerpt: MCP Apps Patterns This document covers common patterns and recipes for building MCP Apps. Tools that are private to Apps Set {@link types!McpUiToolMeta.visibility Tool. meta.ui.visibility} to ["app"] to make tools only callable by Apps (hidden from the model). This is useful for UI driven actions like updating server side state, polling, or other interactions that shouldn't appear in the model's tool list.
